text:
kevin: Quick sync — were doing a brief runtime risk sweep tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. Scope: rebuild base images with latest CVE patches, rotate cosign/KMS envelopes, and verify registry RBAC for builder push keys. Need security + runtime + oncall in the loop.

maya: Which registries exactly? public mirrors or internal only?

kevin: Internal only: gcr (prod & staging) and our private Dedicated registry. No public mirrors. Only images with active workloads.

sam: Request: start with a canary set (3 low-traffic services) and then do 20% batches. Dont blast Dedicated all at once.

kevin: Canary -> phased rollout. If issues, rollback tag and pause.

natalie: RBAC: image-builder SA needs a short-lived grant to push signed images post-key-rotation. Ill draft least-priv policy with 24h expiry.

kevin: Please paste snippet here once ready so infra can review.

natalie: snippet:
```
bindings:
  - role: roles/artifactregistry.writer
    members:
      - serviceAccount:image-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
condition:
  title: "temp-build-access"
  expression: "request.time < timestamp('2026-03-22T11:00:00Z') && resource.name.startsWith('projects/redwood-prod/locations/')"
```

sam: Add the resource.name check yes — infra uses that for scoping.

natalie: will push PR to infra repo.

sre-jen: Oncall: Ill watch canary and have rollback playbook ready. Tag @ops-oncall when canary begins.

ops-oncall: Available 09:00. Ill run smoke scripts and validate KV cache eviction across pool.

kevin: KMS rotation plan (high-level):
1) create new envelope key in KMS
2) add new cosign key version bound to that envelope
3) sign canary images with new key
4) update attestation policy to accept new key fingerprint
5) after 48h, revoke old key version

natalie: Compliance ask: ensure audit logs capture both kms.key.create and cosign.sign events, and sink them to the audit pipeline. Ill coordinate test events.

audit-bot: I will run a schema check post-rotation. Webhook will be sent to /integrations/audit-check with payload sample: {"event":"kms.key.create","actor":"natalie"}.

sam: Runtime note: bump imageDigest pinning window in k8s manifests to avoid old-sha -> new-tag race. Ill add rollout annotation. Example:
```
annotations:
  inference.redwood/release-phase: canary-20260321
```

sre-jen: My smoke checklist:
- curl /health
- 95p latency sanity
- KV cache warmup
- check for node OOMs

maya: Vulnerability triage: if any new image shows CVEs scoring >=7.0 we stop the rollout and open a fast-triage channel. Ill lead triage.

kevin: Can we automate blocking? CI job should fail if image introduces CVE >=7.0 unless a manual override is set.

sam: We have an image-scan job; Ill add a threshold param and PR it today.

natalie: Security control: cosign signer must use KMS-bound SA; no private keys on builders. Builders call KMS.sign only.

kevin: Agreed — no key material leaves KMS. Builders use signer SA to call KMS API.

ops-oncall: During canary Ill also tail audit logs for image push/pull and KMS call logs. Any unexpected auth failures, Ill escalate.

sre-jen: Tagging @security-oncall for incident readiness in case canary triggers unusual error rates.

security-oncall: Standing by. Post canary tags and expected QPS so we can baseline.

kevin: Ill post exact tags 30m before the push. Short checklist to confirm before window:
- [natalie] temp RBAC PR merged
- [sam] image-scan threshold PR merged
- [natalie] new KMS key + cosign config created
- [ops-oncall] smoke scripts ready
- [sre-jen] rollback playbook ready
- [maya] vuln triage ready

maya: Also ask SRE to surface cosign verification trace id in transient logs so we can map runtime failures to signing events.

ops-oncall: Will post a status thread during the sweep with timestamps/results.

sam: Note: if we see image pull auth errors post-RBAC change, check pod metadata-server token TTLs — pods sometimes cache creds.

kevin: Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend the window.

natalie: :thumbsup: 

sam: :thumbsup: 

sre-jen: :thumbsup: 

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: 

maya: :thumbsup:
